sentences.en: Fair competition is necessary for the healthy growth of industry.
sentences.zh: 为了工业健康成长，公平竞争是必要的。

sentences.en: The leisure industry is sinking more money into new resorts.
sentences.zh: 休闲业正在投入更多资金建设新的度假设施。

sentences.en: In any industry a reputation can make or break people.
sentences.zh: 在任何行业里，声誉都能决定一个人的成败。
